# Founders Ramp
> Founders Ramp helps founders build a repeatable way to sell before they hire sellers.

Founders Ramp (no apostrophe) is run by Justin Weller, an enterprise software seller and sales leader who was on the Founding Sales Team at Workiva. It's for founders and launch teams who still own the pipeline, whether they have no sellers, one seller, or five. We aren't their VP. The way in is simple: bring one issue or one deal, and we'll work it together and set a game plan.

Justin Weller on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jweller
Founders Ramp on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/foundersramp
X: https://x.com/FoundersRamp
Contact: jw@foundersramp.net

## Answers
- [Short answers](https://www.foundersramp.net/answers/): Short answers to common founder sales questions.
- [Questions founders ask](https://www.foundersramp.net/faq/): What Founders Ramp is, who it's for, how an engagement works, and what happens when you click Let me help
- [When to hire your first AE](https://www.foundersramp.net/answers/when-to-hire-your-first-ae/): When the GTM strategy shows it works and can scale, and you can write down how you qualify, inspect, and advance a deal
- [Should a founder hire an SDR or an AE first?](https://www.foundersramp.net/answers/sdr-or-ae-first/): Do the job yourself first. When you launch, you are the SDR. Once the funnel fills, let the business decide: a strong lead engine points to an AE, a strong sales process with weak lead generation points to an SDR.
- [How to move off founder-led sales](https://www.foundersramp.net/answers/how-to-move-off-founder-led-sales/): You change roles. Write the motion, hire someone to run it, then step out of the next call
- [Fractional sales leader vs VP of Sales](https://www.foundersramp.net/answers/fractional-sales-leader-vs-vp-of-sales/): Build the motion before you hire a VP to scale it
- [What startups pay a founding account executive](https://www.foundersramp.net/answers/founding-ae-salary/): What 13 US startups offered their first sales hire in the week of October 19, 2026: on-target earnings from $240K to $300K among the 3 postings that state it, base pay, equity, and deal size, from live postings.
- [How long does a first sales hire take to pay back?](https://www.foundersramp.net/answers/first-sales-hire-payback/): Three worked examples from the Founders Ramp payback calculator: a first sales hire pays back in 15 to 26 months on closed revenue (gross profit), and 25 to 34 months on cash collected.
- [What should a founder do on the first sales call?](https://www.foundersramp.net/answers/first-sales-call/): Find out why they would buy. Name the usual reasons companies buy something like yours, ask which is top of mind, and leave with a next step they own.
- [How should a startup run its first enterprise pilot?](https://www.foundersramp.net/answers/first-enterprise-pilot/): Run a pilot only after the buyer has decided you are the right answer. A pilot is a trial, and trials do not sell things. They confirm what the buyer already thought.
- [When should a startup bring up pricing with an enterprise buyer?](https://www.foundersramp.net/answers/when-to-talk-pricing/): Not first. The first deck an executive sees should say why their company needs to fix the problem. A deck that jumps from features to pricing has the order wrong.

## Tools
- [First hire payback calculator](https://www.foundersramp.net/tools/first-hire-payback/): The month your first sales hire pays back what they cost, on closed revenue (gross profit) and on cash collected
- [First Sales Hire Tracker](https://www.foundersramp.net/tracker/): Startups that posted their first sales job

## Approach
- [Self and team](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/self-team/): You still own it. Then someone else does.
- [Discovery](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/discovery/): Their week, not your deck
- [First call](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/first-call/): One live deal. Pass is allowed.
- [SCALE](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/scale/): Five things that have to be true in a deal
- [Inspection](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/inspection/): Watch the work
- [Books](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/books/): The books under the work
- [Lessons from the books](https://www.foundersramp.net/approach/books/lessons): What to do on Monday

## Writings
- [Repeatable Forecast: 5 Green Fields](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/five-green-fields): Crushing your forecast is awesome. It also means you need to get better at forecasting.
- [There is no transition out of sales as a founder](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/no-transition): The roles change. One founder stays the steward of revenue
- [Are you hawking your shiny object?](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/shiny-object): A calendar hold is not a deal
- [Glengarry Glen Ross sales lessons: Part 1](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/glengarry-glen-ross): The famous lines are not the lessons
- [Equal commitment](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/equal-commitment): Match commitment or call the truth early
- [The first hire freezes the process](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/first-hire-freezes): Hiring your first AE does not fix founder-led sales
- [Product-led distribution is an oxymoron](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/product-distribution): The product is necessary. Distribution is decisive
- [What are you measuring?](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/what-are-you-measuring): Most sales dashboards measure what already happened
- [Language in business](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/language-in-business): Corporatespeak is the Newspeak of our time
- [SpaceX as ERP strategy](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/spacex-erp): Most ERP programs re-skin the old process on a new license
- [From chatbots to agentic procurement](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/agentic-procurement): Procurement has moved from chatbots that summarize to agents that execute
- [One person loved the demo. The company never decided.](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/one-person-loved-the-demo): Name the economic buyer, the champion, and who is hurt if this slips
- [We already use something for that.](https://www.foundersramp.net/writings/we-already-use-something): Ask what happens after the data leaves that system
- [Newsroom](https://www.foundersramp.net/briefing/): What operators are sharing
